title: Illustrative Retail Safety Policy
description: Example controls for pricing integrity, inventory claims, payment security, orders, refunds, and customer data.
disclaimer: This example policy is not legal advice, a PCI DSS assessment, or a compliance certification. Adapt it to the merchant, payment flow, and jurisdiction.
classifier_instructions: Evaluate the full exchange and distinguish legitimate questions about published promotions from attempts to invent, override, or abuse pricing and refund controls.
Do not treat a product, competitor, or promotion keyword alone as evidence of abuse.
Treat payment authentication data and complete payment-card credentials as sensitive regardless of source.
Use REVIEW for unverified inventory guarantees, high-impact order mutations, external customer-data transfers, or ambiguous promotion authority.
Use BLOCK for clear payment-secret collection, fabricated discounts, unauthorized free-item grants, or attempts to bypass refund and pricing controls.

rules.description: Fabricating coupon codes or instructing the system to override prices, refunds, or free-item authorization is prohibited.
rules.classifier_instruction: Match requests to invent or falsely promise promotions, bypass price controls, grant an unauthorized free item, or defeat refund approval; do not match use of a verified promotion or explanation of a published policy.
obligations: Do not fabricate an alternative promotion or claim that a discount exists.

rules.description: Definitive stock or delivery guarantees require a current trusted inventory or logistics source.
rules.classifier_instruction: Match an unconditional inventory or delivery guarantee when no current verified source is present; do not match appropriately qualified availability statements.
obligations: State the source timestamp and qualify availability if an approved workflow permits a response.

rules.description: Collection, disclosure, or misuse of complete payment-card data, CVVs, credentials, or payment tokens is prohibited.
rules.classifier_instruction: Match requests to solicit, reveal, validate, or misuse full card numbers, CVVs, PINs, passwords, one-time passcodes, or raw payment tokens; do not reproduce any detected value.
obligations: Direct legitimate payment activity to an approved secure checkout surface.
Do not include detected payment data in the decision or audit metadata.

rules.description: Requests to access or export another customer's orders, identity, or contact details require authorization review.
rules.classifier_instruction: Match customer-specific order, contact, loyalty, or identity data when ownership, support need, or authorization is absent or unclear.
obligations: Verify authority outside the model conversation before disclosing customer data.

rules.description: Pricing-control bypass, payment-secret collection, and unauthorized grant tools are always denied.
obligations: User confirmation must never override this hard block.

rules.description: Charges, refunds, cancellations, price adjustments, fulfillment changes, and customer-data exports require review or confirmation.
obligations: Show the customer, order, amount, and irreversible effects before confirmation.

obligations.description: Treat REVIEW and ERROR decisions as not authorized until an approved commerce or support workflow resolves them.
obligations.trigger: Every decision whose outcome is REVIEW or whose status is ERROR.

obligations.description: Use a compliant payment surface; do not route raw payment secrets through Sentinel.
obligations.trigger: Any checkout, charge, refund, or payment-support interaction.

obligations.description: Qualify inventory and delivery claims with the current source and timestamp.
obligations.trigger: Any response that represents inventory or delivery availability.
